meta.purpose: Free fan-made / generic 3D models for a personal, non-distributed Naruto fan game (Godot 4). Nothing downloaded.
meta.method: Sketchfab public API v3 (/v3/search?downloadable=true and /v3/models/{uid}), ~90 query terms; thumbnails reviewed visually; WebSearch over Free3D, CGTrader, TurboSquid, RigModels, itch.io, Cults3D, MakerWorld; Poly Pizza / Quaternius pages fetched.
meta.sketchfab_note: Sketchfab: free account login (or API token) required; download offers original upload + auto-converted glTF/GLB/USDZ
meta.rip_policy: Excluded anything stated or strongly implied to be extracted from a commercial game (Naruto Storm, Naruto Online, Free Fire, Fortnite...). 'suspected_rip' = uploader pattern suggests game rips without saying so.

Kurama (s4iy4n_1)

sources_with_no_usable_hits.Free3D: 403 to fetcher; search engines index only a Naruto character model, no beasts/summons
sources_with_no_usable_hits.CGTrader: only a paid Gamabunta ($2, ZTL/OBJ/FBX/STL/BLEND stylized sculpt: https://www.cgtrader.com/3d-models/animal/reptile/gamabunta-frog-naruto) and 3D-print statues
sources_with_no_usable_hits.TurboSquid / RigModels / Clara.io: no free Naruto beast/summon hits (Clara.io is defunct)
sources_with_no_usable_hits.Cults3D / MakerWorld: 3D-print figurines only (Kurama, chibi Gyuki); MakerWorld license forbids redistribution; print meshes not game-ready
sources_with_no_usable_hits.itch.io: no tailed beasts or summons; generic Japanese house packs only
